A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same study, Prior Learning in Introspective VAEs, with complete main text and supplementary material. All 29 pages were compared through text extraction and rendering; the scientific content matches.

before.justification: v1 reports original density-estimation, image-generation and representation-learning results in Tables 1–2, with additional empirical analyses in the supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–2 and the supplementary experiments unchanged.

M1.justification: Prior–decoder cooperation, stop-gradient treatment, adaptive variance clipping and responsibility regularization are unchanged, including their supplementary formulations.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same four 2D distributions and MNIST, Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10. The supplementary synthetic-distribution scenarios and representation-learning tasks also match.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same standard-Gaussian VAE and S-IntroVAE baselines and MoG configurations. Comparator membership in the image experiments and supplementary baseline-reproduction comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, hyperparameter searches, 100-sample Monte Carlo KL approximation, image-training warm-up and prior-component configurations are unchanged. Supplementary testing procedures also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the same clipping-stability experiment, encoder-behavior analysis, MoG ablations, responsibility-regularization sensitivity analysis and latent-space visualizations.

E5.justification: Both specify mean and standard deviation across five seeds for the 2D experiments. Repeated-run disclosures and uncertainty reporting throughout the main text and supplement are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in main Tables 1–2 and supplementary Tables 3–5 match. The plotted results, qualitative examples and reported findings are also identical.

T1.justification: The Nash-equilibrium assumptions, theorems and proofs, assumption-free optimal-ELBO analysis, prior–encoder conjecture and regularization derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusions retain identical claims about prior learning, equilibrium preservation, the two regularizations and benefits for generation and representation learning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of training instability, inactive prior modes, dataset-dependent benefits and latent-space structure are unchanged. No applicability qualifications or limitations are added or removed.

D1.justification: The new Acknowledgements identifies NAISS at C3SE as the computing-resource provider, which v1 does not disclose. This adds limited resource provenance; implementation details, hyperparameters and code/data access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and complete reference list are identical. References shifted between pages 8 and 9 are retained works, not citation additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 removes Shashi Nagarajan from the author line, updates the arXiv version/date stamp and inserts an Acknowledgements section before References. The scientific prose and supplementary structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The shorter author line and added acknowledgements cause limited layout changes on pages 1, 8 and 9, including bibliography reflow. All figures, tables and supplementary page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding and computing-resource attribution and revises the author block, but leaves the methods, proofs, experimental evidence and interpretations identical, including the supplement. These limited administrative and provenance changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
